purpose: make sure contracts and legal and regulatory obligations are understood, assigned and checked before work begins and during it
entry_criteria: A contract or obligation applies to the work
Legal or compliance contact is known
procedure: List each obligation from the contract and regulations in plain terms: what, who, by when and how it is evidenced.
Map every obligation to an owner and a delivery stage, and flag any obligation the team cannot meet.
Check the work plan against restrictions such as data location, subcontractors, licences and reporting duties.
Raise conflicts and gaps with legal before work starts, and record the answers.
Collect evidence of compliance as the work proceeds, and keep it where audit can find it.
Review obligations at each major change and at contract milestones.
acceptance_criteria: Each obligation has an owner and evidence
Unmeetable obligations were raised with legal
Restrictions are checked against the plan

validation.check: sample five obligations and trace each to an owner and evidence item
check the register lists every contract in scope

failure_modes.detection: Plan uses a region the contract forbids
failure_modes.response: Change the plan or seek approval

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A client contract requires data to stay in one country and 24-hour breach notice. The register assigns owners to both, and a plan using an overseas log service is changed before work begins.
